purpose: Repeat the single v11 bridge diagnostic after repairing only the controlled-U construction at the tokenizer's actual 10x10 consumer grid.

architecture.contextual_relevance: Frozen v10.1 step-120 same-view R path; computed once per matched group.
architecture.language_input: Frozen U tokens plus trainable K bridge tokens in the second VLM pass.
architecture.no_u_ablation: Baseline frozen ORION visual tokens only; no U tokens and no K bridge tokens.

data_scope.changed_records: Only the 640 on/off-path QA records change their U tensor reference and derived sidecar/structured targets; 960 non-control records retain canonical inputs and semantics.
data_scope.language_evaluation: One fixed first keyframe per event; all four controlled variants; task-relevance QA only.

consumer_grid_precondition.construction: 10x10 matched Gaussian controls followed by exact 4x4 block expansion

controlled_u_gates.decision: If either train or dev controlled-U gate fails, stop before language optimization.

r_diagnostics.reason: The warm-start R checkpoint already failed its preregistered v10.1 recall gate; this replacement freezes and reports it rather than granting a new R claim.

training.event_sampling: one event per step in deterministic round-robin order, shuffled keyframes within event

decision_rules.controlled_u_fails: With the consumer-grid control now valid, record this as evidence that the frozen contextual R cannot support the interface; repair R target, coordinate binding or independent-event coverage before any language extension.
decision_rules.controlled_u_passes_language_fails: Repair the K-token/QA bridge; do not retrain Stage1, start Stage2-P or add closed-loop jobs.
decision_rules.controlled_u_and_language_pass: The engineering U-to-semantics bridge is viable; next test learned Stage1 U on independent native/sensor degradation before Stage2-P.
decision_rules.r_diagnostics_fail: Retain R as an explicit independent bottleneck; a v11.1 language pass does not erase the v10.1 R failure.

launch_locks.unlock_requires: Fresh CPU preflight plus a separate hash-bound single-run v11.1 launch amendment.

claim_boundary: A pass would identify controlled spatial-U use in one frozen-R engineering interface after repairing the consumer-grid control. It would not validate learned Stage1 U, formal event generalization, planning, closed-loop behavior or safety.
